artifact_groups.description: Retained tables derived before the current repository migration from historical generation, prediction, measurement, and selection records. The exact original creation timestamps, artifact IDs, model/checkpoint identifiers, and full output-generating parameters are unavailable.
Comparison narrative and figures created before the current repository migration. They were retained without remeasurement or plot regeneration.

Checksums copied from the prior package. These files describe historical source/package holdings, including files not committed in the current package; they are not current-directory integrity manifests.
Control and explanatory records created or edited for repository organization. They report historical evidence but are not original execution outputs or new scientific measurements.

artifact_naming_decision.reason: Renaming requires verified artifact IDs, UTC execution timestamps, run references, model identifiers, and parameters. Those components are unavailable, and fabricating them would create false provenance.
artifact_naming_decision.future_rule: Any newly generated scientific artifact must use the repository-mandated component order and must be registered with its verified metadata and checksum.

historical_source_reference_schemes.historical-workspace: Location relative to the removed machine-specific historical workspace root; the referenced source is not committed here.
historical_source_reference_schemes.historical-package: Location relative to the former historical result-package root; the referenced file may be absent from the retained review package.
